ai_summary: **Executive Summary: Dollex Agrotech Limited Project Extension**  Dollex Agrotech Limited has announced a further extension of its project's Scheduled Commercial Operation Date (SCOD) to December 31, 2026, from the previously announced June 2026. This delay, despite completed plant installation, stems from pending critical statutory approvals from PESO and the Madhya Pradesh Pollution Control Board, significantly postponing revenue generation and impacting financial projections. The repeated extensions and ongoing reliance on external, unpredictable regulatory approvals represent a red flag regarding project execution and potential future operational uncertainties.
